title: Sustainable Commute Mode Share
dataSources: Carbon estimates (`carbon:estimate`), recycling weight (`recycling:weight`), food waste (`foodwaste:log`), repairs (`repair:event`).
app: Sustainability telemetry — carbon-footprint apps, home recycling scales, food-waste logs, and repair / reuse journals — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, MQTT, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=carbon:estimate category=commute
| stats sum(distance_km) as km by mode
| eventstats sum(km) as total_km
| eval mode_share_pct=round(100*km/total_km,1)
| sort - mode_share_pct
description: Shows what share of your commuting distance happens by low-carbon versus high-carbon transport modes.
value: Mode share is more actionable than a monthly carbon total because it maps directly to everyday choices.
implementation: Tag commute carbon events with mode and distance; calculate each mode's percentage share of total distance.
visualization: Pie chart of commute distance share by mode.

references.title: EPA — reducing wasted food at home

grandmaExplanation: It ranks how much of your travel is happening by greener ways of getting around.
